Full reads Ziggs/Ziggs/Ziggs/Skill/Ziggs/Skill/Ziggs; content reads Ziggs/Ziggs/Ziggs/Skill/Ziggs/Skill/Ziggs on win[] while every single why says the opposite ('You own level 2', 'Level 3 stays yours', 'First item favours you', 'Two items in you still beat him 1v1'). The packet chart and the mirror both give [Skill, Zaahen, Zaahen, Skill, Skill, Zaahen, Zaahen].
audit.why: Six of seven rows currently tell a paying reader he loses a lane the same page then explains he wins. The mirror already wrote its side with ratings 5/3/3/-/5/3/3, which inverts exactly to 5/7/7/-/5/7/7 here.
audit.corrected: All six mismatched rows flipped in both layers as one atomic group, with the inverted ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Satchel Charge — the one cooldown the entire page is built around — never had a number, and neither did Mega Inferno Bomb.
audit.why: Satchel is 20/18/16/14/12s; at rank 1 that is a twenty-second window with no escape at all, which is what makes the 3-5 dive window real. Mega Inferno Bomb is 120/95/70s and adds no self-peel.
audit.corrected: spikes[0], spikes[1], mid, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with the numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hexplosive Minefield does not appear anywhere on the page, Short Fuse's auto-attack reset is unmentioned, Satchel Charge is described only as his self-peel when it displaces you as well, and Zaahen's W is again credited with sustain ('Sustain his poke with W Ominous Return') it does not have.
audit.why: The minefield is 16s, 900 range and slows on contact — it is the thing that actually makes a dive fail, more than the Satchel. Satchel knocking you away is what breaks a committed dash. Zaahen's healing is on Q's double slash; his W is a stab-and-pull.
audit.corrected: spikes[2], wants.you[2], dosFull[1..2].d and dontsFull[0..2].d rewritten with the minefield, the reset tell, the two-way knockback and the Q heal.

edits.before: Ziggs is a squishy ranged mage with no mobility beyond his W (Satchel Charge) self-knockback. His only escape is one Satchel, so bait it: threaten with Q Darkin Glaive spacing and E Golden Onslaught, force the W, then dash in once it's on cooldown. Walk through his Bouncing Bomb (Q) poke by side-stepping the bounce and punish every time he steps up to CS.
edits.after: Ziggs is a squishy ranged mage whose only mobility is the Satchel Charge (W, 20s at rank 1) self-knockback — and it throws you away as well as him. Bait it: threaten the dash, force the W, then commit while it is down. Side-step the Bouncing Bomb (Q, 6s, 850 range) bounce, watch the Short Fuse auto that resets on every cast, and punish him whenever he steps up to CS.

edits.before: Ziggs at 6 gains a global R (Mega Inferno Bomb) but zero extra self-peel; in lane he's still a one-Satchel champion. Keep dive pressure on — when his W is down he has no answer to your E engage, and your R Final Retribution guarantees the kill on his squishy frame.
edits.after: Ziggs at 6 gains a long-range R (Mega Inferno Bomb, 120s at rank 1) but zero extra self-peel; in lane he is still a one-Satchel champion. Keep the dive pressure on — while his W is down he has no answer to your dash, and your R heals off the damage as you finish him.

edits.before: Even after his first mage item Ziggs is defenceless in a 1v1 — his damage is waveclear-and-poke, not a duel. Sustain his poke with W Ominous Return, hard-shove, and all-in the moment his Satchel is spent; he can't fight back once you're on him.
edits.after: Even after his first mage item Ziggs is defenceless in a 1v1 — his damage is waveclear and poke, not a duel. Heal the poke back with your Q double slash, hard-shove, and all-in the moment his Satchel is spent; he cannot fight back once you are on him.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are your window and the reason the chart is yours: Ziggs has exactly one mobility tool in Satchel Charge and no way to survive your E Golden Onslaught engage once it's spent. Force the W with a feint, dash in, and your R Final Retribution closes on his low-HP frame. Just track his Satchel cooldown and don't eat free Bouncing Bomb poke.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are your window and the reason the chart is yours: Ziggs has exactly one mobility tool in Satchel Charge, twenty seconds at rank 1, and no way to survive your dash once it is spent. Force the W with a feint, dash in, and your R closes on his low-HP frame. Track that Satchel, refuse free Bouncing Bomb poke, and cross his minefield before you commit.

notes: Worst chart in the slice: six of seven rows were Ziggs-sided in both layers while every content why explained why Zaahen wins those same rows, and both layers disagreed with the packet and with the mirror's stated reference. All six flipped as one group with the inverted mirror ratings. Hexplosive Minefield was absent from the entire page.
